title: UI & Utility Components
summary: This module provides core utilities for asynchronous operations, concurrency management, data formatting, and integrates with various user interfaces (UIs) like AG-UI and Vercel AI, as well as the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

nodes.label: Deprecate Callable
nodes.title: Deprecated Callable Decorator
nodes.description: Marks functions as deprecated, providing a warning message upon use to guide developers towards newer alternatives.

nodes.label: Execute Async in Thread
nodes.title: Run in Executor
nodes.description: Executes synchronous functions in a thread pool, enabling non-blocking I/O for async contexts and improving responsiveness.

nodes.label: Extract Union Type Args
nodes.title: Get Union Arguments
nodes.description: Utility to extract component types from a Python `Union` type hint, useful for type introspection.

nodes.label: Retrieve Async Event Loop
nodes.title: Get Event Loop
nodes.description: Ensures an asyncio event loop is available, creating one if none exists, for managing concurrent tasks.

nodes.label: Manage Concurrent Tasks
nodes.title: Concurrency Limiter
nodes.description: Controls the maximum number of simultaneous operations, preventing resource exhaustion and ensuring stable performance.

nodes.label: Format Python to XML
nodes.title: Format as XML
nodes.description: Converts Python objects into a structured XML string, often used for LLM prompts due to their parsing capabilities.

nodes.label: Deprecated Usage Tracking
nodes.title: Usage (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for the `RunUsage` class, used for tracking resource consumption and model token usage.

nodes.label: MCP HTTP Server
nodes.title: MCPServerHTTP
nodes.description: Connects to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers via HTTP using Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time communication.

nodes.label: Load MCP Server Configs
nodes.title: Load MCPServers
nodes.description: Parses configuration files to initialize and manage MCP server connections, supporting environment variable expansion.

nodes.label: Define MCP Resource
nodes.title: Resource
nodes.description: Represents a discoverable resource available on an MCP server, including its URI, size, and metadata.

nodes.label: Define MCP Resource Template
nodes.title: ResourceTemplate
nodes.description: Describes a parameterized resource on an MCP server using URI templates, allowing dynamic resource access.

nodes.label: Base UI Adapter
nodes.title: UIAdapter
nodes.description: Abstract class for integrating with UIs, translating frontend requests to agent runs and vice-versa, handling message sanitization.

nodes.label: Base UI Event Stream
nodes.title: UIEventStream
nodes.description: Abstract class for transforming internal agent events into UI-specific streaming formats, dispatching to various handlers.

nodes.label: Run AG-UI Agent
nodes.title: run_ag_ui
nodes.description: Executes an agent with AG-UI specific input, streaming events compatible with the AG-UI protocol for interactive experiences.

nodes.label: AG-UI Frontend Toolset
nodes.title: _AGUIFrontendToolset
nodes.description: Provides a toolset interface for tools defined and managed by the AG-UI frontend, enabling agent interaction with UI capabilities.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Adapter
nodes.title: VercelAIAdapter
nodes.description: Specialized UI adapter for the Vercel AI protocol, handling chat requests and responses, including tool approval workflows.

nodes.label: Configure Frontend API
nodes.title: configure_frontend
nodes.description: An API endpoint to provide frontend clients with configuration details like available models and tools.

nodes.label: Handle Vercel AI Chat
nodes.title: post_chat
nodes.description: API endpoint that processes incoming chat requests from Vercel AI clients, orchestrating agent responses and streaming events.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Step Start
nodes.title: StepStartUIPart
nodes.description: Indicates the beginning of a distinct processing step within a Vercel AI message stream, for UI rendering.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Tool Input Streaming
nodes.title: ToolInputStreamingPart
nodes.description: Represents a tool receiving streaming input from the Vercel AI frontend, indicating ongoing data transfer.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Tool Approval Responded
nodes.title: ToolApprovalRespondedPart
nodes.description: Signals that a user has approved or denied a tool execution request in Vercel AI, with execution pending.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Dynamic Tool Input Streaming
nodes.title: DynamicToolInputStreamingPart
nodes.description: A dynamic tool receiving streaming input from the Vercel AI frontend, indicating active data flow.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Dynamic Tool Input Available
nodes.title: DynamicToolInputAvailablePart
nodes.description: A dynamic tool's input is fully available and ready for processing in Vercel AI, awaiting execution.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Dynamic Tool Output Available
nodes.title: DynamicToolOutputAvailablePart
nodes.description: A dynamic tool has successfully produced its output in the Vercel AI stream, ready for display.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Dynamic Tool Approval Requested
nodes.title: DynamicToolApprovalRequestedPart
nodes.description: A dynamic tool requires user approval before execution in Vercel AI, pausing the workflow.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Dynamic Tool Approval Responded
nodes.title: DynamicToolApprovalRespondedPart
nodes.description: User has responded to a dynamic tool's approval request in Vercel AI, with execution pending.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Dynamic Tool Output Denied
nodes.title: DynamicToolOutputDeniedPart
nodes.description: A dynamic tool's execution or output was explicitly denied by the user in Vercel AI, reaching a terminal state.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Source URL Chunk
nodes.title: SourceUrlChunk
nodes.description: A response chunk containing a URL reference to a source document in Vercel AI, for displaying external links.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Source Document Chunk
nodes.title: SourceDocumentChunk
nodes.description: A response chunk containing metadata for a source document in Vercel AI, for displaying document details.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Data Chunk
nodes.title: DataChunk
nodes.description: A generic data chunk for transmitting arbitrary data in Vercel AI responses, allowing flexible content.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Abort Chunk
nodes.title: AbortChunk
nodes.description: A signal to the Vercel AI frontend to abort the current operation, typically due to an error or user cancellation.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Message Metadata Chunk
nodes.title: MessageMetadataChunk
nodes.description: A response chunk containing additional metadata for a Vercel AI message, providing context or supplementary information.

nodes.label: Agent Core
nodes.title: Agent Core Module
nodes.description: Provides the fundamental agent abstractions and execution logic, including `AbstractAgent`.

nodes.label: Tools & Capabilities
nodes.title: Tools & Capabilities Module
nodes.description: Offers toolset definitions and agent capabilities like `AbstractToolset` and `NativeTool`.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: Core Utilities
groups.description: General-purpose utilities for asynchronous programming, concurrency control, and data manipulation.

groups.label: MCP Integration
groups.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration
groups.description: Components for integrating with and defining resources for the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

groups.label: UI Adapters & API
groups.title: User Interface Adapters and API Endpoints
groups.description: Provides abstractions and concrete implementations for integrating with various UIs (AG-UI, Vercel AI) and exposing API endpoints.

groups.label: Vercel AI Protocol Types
groups.title: Vercel AI Protocol Message Types
groups.description: Defines the data structures for various message parts and chunks used in the Vercel AI protocol for communication.
